about.title: About Family Buddy
about.what: Family Buddy is a free guide for parents of 1- to 5-year-olds. From your child's age, it shows what they're roughly going through now, what's good to know at this stage, and ideas for things to do together indoors and outdoors. It is a non-commercial project run by {{CONTROLLER_NAME}}. Contact: {{CONTACT_EMAIL}}.
about.notMedical: The texts are general information about what many children do at a given age. They are not meant to assess or track any individual child's development, and they don't replace check-ups or a doctor. Age ranges are approximate. For babies born prematurely, "corrected age" (counted from the due date) is usually used until age two.
about.how: We draft the texts with the help of AI, from the public expert sources listed below. A person who is responsible for the content reads and approves every text before it is published. If you spot a mistake, please tell us.
about.safety: Always stay close during activities, and adapt them to your child and your surroundings. Near water or roads, stay within arm's reach.
about.cdc: Some content is based on materials developed by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), available free of charge at cdc.gov. Use of these materials, including links to CDC websites, does not imply endorsement by CDC, the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) or the United States Government.
about.ogl: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
about.ccby: Cíbochová R.: Psychomotor development during the first year of life (Psychomotorický vývoj dítěte v prvním roce života). Česko-slovenská pediatrie 2024; 79(6): 314–322. Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Information adapted.
about.who: The Nurturing Care Framework (WHO, UNICEF, World Bank, 2018) inspires our approach; we don't reproduce its text. WHO did not create this app and is not responsible for its content.
about.links: Links to other websites (e.g. UNICEF, NHS, NZIP) lead to their own pages. We don't reproduce their content, and these organisations do not endorse this app.
about.rr: Room Repeater is a separate app. Opening it passes no details about your child.
footer.disclaimer: Not medical advice. Every child grows at their own pace. If anything about your child's development worries you, talk to your child's doctor.
